description: Robot gripper moving balls between rooms
layout: Rooms side by side, robot moves between them
legend: Show ball colors and gripper states

critical_relations.at-robby: robot at-robby room1 means robot is in room1
critical_relations.at: ball1 at room1 means ball1 is in room1
critical_relations.carry: gripper carry ball1 means gripper is holding ball1 - draw near gripper
critical_relations.free: gripper free means gripper is not holding anything

positioning_rules: Rooms should be drawn side by side
Robot should be shown in its current room
Balls should be drawn inside their room
Carried balls should be shown near the gripper
